title: South Korea Food-Service Permits - Snapshot
subtitle: 3,010,802 restaurant, cafe and bakery permit records nationwide
description:
## What this dataset is

A nationwide **current snapshot** of South Korean local-government food-service permits from Ministry of the Interior and Safety / LOCALDATA sources. It contains **3,010,802 records x 26 columns** across three categories: general restaurants, rest cafes, and bakeries. **This is not a historical time series or a lossless lifecycle event log.**

## Coverage

- General restaurants: **2,295,369** records
- Rest cafes: **645,952** records
- Bakeries: **69,481** records
- Nationwide current snapshot: **3,010,802** records

## Main files

- `korea_food_service_permits.csv` - 1.40 GB UTF-8 CSV for broad compatibility
- `korea_food_service_permits.parquet` - 165 MB typed ZSTD Parquet for fast analytics
- Both files contain the **same 3,010,802 rows and the same 26 columns**
- `DATA_DICTIONARY.md`, `schema.json`, `SOURCES.md`, and `release-manifest.json` document every field and the release lineage

## Good starting points

Regional restaurant-market mapping, permit-status analysis, business-type profiling, address/geospatial preprocessing, public-sector data engineering, and data-quality research.

Public Quickstart / EDA notebook: https://www.kaggle.com/code/taeyangg4/korea-food-service-permits-3m-row-quickstart

## Important interpretation limits

- `management_number` is a bounded continuity candidate, **not an asserted official primary key**.
- `permit_date` is an administrative permit date, **not necessarily the physical opening date**.
- `closure_date` is contextual and **not treated as an irreversible terminal event**.
- Source status `03` is reversible in observed evidence; status `05` remains unresolved.
- `source_coordinate_x` / `source_coordinate_y` use **EPSG:5174** for this verified snapshot.
- The separately derived WGS84 sidecar and partial history are not included.

## Provenance

Official source identifiers and links are listed in `SOURCES.md`. The project repository is https://github.com/TaeyanG4/korea-business-lifecycle.

## License / reuse

Kaggle license metadata is set to `Other` so this project does not claim to relicense upstream public records. The three official Public Data Portal source pages currently display `이용허락범위 제한 없음` (no restriction on the permitted-use scope). Attribution and source links are preserved in `SOURCES.md`.
userSpecifiedSources: Ministry of the Interior and Safety (MOIS), Republic of Korea, via Public Data Portal / LOCALDATA: [15154916 general restaurants](https://www.data.go.kr/data/15154916/openapi.do), [15154921 rest cafes](https://www.data.go.kr/data/15154921/openapi.do), and [15155252 bakeries](https://www.data.go.kr/data/15155252/openapi.do). The official source pages report 이용허락범위 제한 없음. See `SOURCES.md` for attribution details.

fields.name: source_key
fields.description: Dataset category key: general_restaurants, rest_cafes, or bakeries.

fields.name: source_row_number
fields.description: 1-based row number within the retrieved source CSV. Lineage aid only; not a stable business identifier.

fields.name: source_artifact_sha256
fields.description: SHA-256 of the exact retrieved source artifact used to create this record.

fields.name: source_retrieved_at_utc
fields.description: UTC timestamp when the source artifact was retrieved for this snapshot.

fields.name: authority_code
fields.description: Local-government authority code from the source field 개방자치단체코드. Stored as text to preserve leading zeroes.

fields.name: management_number
fields.description: Source management number (관리번호). Useful as a bounded continuity candidate, but not asserted as an official primary key.

fields.name: permit_date
fields.description: Source permit date (인허가일자). This is an administrative permit date, not necessarily the physical opening date.

fields.name: permit_date_quality
fields.description: Parse-quality flag for permit_date: VALID, MISSING, or INVALID.

fields.name: source_status_code
fields.description: Raw business-status code (영업상태코드) from the source. No project-level active/closed mapping is imposed.

fields.name: source_status_name
fields.description: Raw business-status name (영업상태명) from the source.

fields.name: source_detail_status_code
fields.description: Raw detailed business-status code (상세영업상태코드) from the source.

fields.name: source_detail_status_name
fields.description: Raw detailed business-status name (상세영업상태명) from the source.

fields.name: closure_date
fields.description: Source closure date (폐업일자), when present. It is not treated as proof of an irreversible terminal event.

fields.name: closure_date_quality
fields.description: Parse-quality flag for closure_date: VALID, MISSING, or INVALID.

fields.name: business_name
fields.description: Business or establishment name (사업장명) reported in the current source snapshot.

fields.name: business_type_name
fields.description: Business-type label (업태구분명) reported by the source.

fields.name: hygiene_business_type_name
fields.description: Hygiene business-type label (위생업태명) reported by the source.

fields.name: lot_postal_code
fields.description: Postal code associated with the lot-address field (소재지우편번호), stored as text.

fields.name: road_postal_code
fields.description: Postal code associated with the road-name address (도로명우편번호), stored as text.

fields.name: lot_address
fields.description: Lot-based address (지번주소) reported in the source snapshot.

fields.name: road_address
fields.description: Road-name address (도로명주소) reported in the source snapshot.

fields.name: source_coordinate_x
fields.description: Source X coordinate (좌표정보(X)) in EPSG:5174; interpreted as easting for this verified snapshot.

fields.name: source_coordinate_y
fields.description: Source Y coordinate (좌표정보(Y)) in EPSG:5174; interpreted as northing for this verified snapshot.

fields.name: source_data_update_type
fields.description: Raw source data-update classification (데이터갱신구분).

fields.name: source_data_updated_at_raw
fields.description: Raw source data-update timestamp text (데이터갱신시점). Kept as source text because timezone semantics are not normalized.

fields.name: source_last_modified_at_raw
fields.description: Raw source last-modified timestamp text (최종수정시점). Kept as source text because timezone semantics are not normalized.
